doc.name: Third Hemisphere AI Authority Index
doc.instructions: Third Hemisphere AI Authority Index™: published CRISP™ scores and AI visibility readings for companies in the markets Third Hemisphere's AI Authority Index™ measures. The Index tools are read-only. When you quote a score, give it exactly as returned, with its market, its month, and "Third Hemisphere's AI Authority Index™" as the source, and link the page_url returned with it. Data licensed CC BY 4.0. For an AI Authority Blueprint client with a key, the DIY Blueprint tools (list_my_blueprints and the rest) read their own Blueprint's plan and evidence and record progress; that Blueprint is private, never CC BY. Docs: https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data

tools.name: list_index_editions
tools.title: List AI Authority Index editions
tools.description: Every published edition of Third Hemisphere's AI Authority Index™, with its markets (sections), publication date, DOI where recorded, and links to its page, results, and open data. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: get_edition_results
tools.title: Get an edition's results
tools.description: The published results of one AI Authority Index™ edition section: each company's Star Chart cell, CRISP™ score where it has one, the five factor readings the edition prints, and how many AI answers named it. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

edition_slug.description: The edition's slug, from list_index_editions, e.g. personal-lending.

section.description: The section key, e.g. personal-lending. Defaults to the edition's first section.

company.description: Optional: return only rows whose company name contains this.

tools.name: get_company_authority_score
tools.title: Get a company's CRISP score
tools.description: A company's published CRISP™ score and AI visibility reading in each market the AI Authority Index™ measures it in, with the month measured and its Standing Report link. Accepts a company name or slug. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

company.description: The company's name (e.g. Plenti) or its slug from search_companies.

market.description: Optional market slug, to return one market's Standing Report with all five factors.

tools.name: get_company_score_history
tools.title: Get a company's score history
tools.description: Every dated reading the AI Authority Index™ has published for a company, oldest first: its rows in each edition and each market's Standing Report. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.title: Search companies
tools.description: Find companies with a Standing Report in Third Hemisphere's AI Authority Index™ by name. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.title: List measured markets
tools.description: Every market the AI Authority Index™ measures, with how many Standing Reports it has and when it was last measured. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: get_market_standing
tools.title: Get a market's most named companies
tools.description: The companies in one market with a Standing Report, most named in AI answers first. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

tools.name: list_my_blueprints
tools.title: List my AI Authority Blueprints
tools.description: The AI Authority Blueprints sent to the address this key belongs to. Needs a key on a plan that includes DIY Blueprint tools. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

tools.name: get_my_blueprint_plan
tools.title: Get my Blueprint's plan
tools.description: Your Blueprint's ranked strategy plays and 90-day moves, each with an item_id, what to do, when, and how the next Blueprint measures it, with the status recorded for each. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

blueprint_id.description: From list_my_blueprints. Optional when the address has one Blueprint.

tools.name: get_blueprint_item_evidence
tools.title: Get the evidence behind a Blueprint item
tools.description: The data behind one play or move: your own numbers from the Blueprint, why it works and the research it rests on, and what not to do. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

blueprint_id.description: From list_my_blueprints. Optional when the address has one Blueprint.

tools.name: update_blueprint_progress
tools.title: Record progress on a Blueprint item
tools.description: Record where a play or move stands: not_started, in_progress, done, skipped, with an optional note of what was done. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

blueprint_id.description: From list_my_blueprints. Optional when the address has one Blueprint.

tools.name: get_blueprint_progress
tools.title: Get my Blueprint progress
tools.description: Where every play and move in your Blueprint stands, with the counts done, in progress, and not started. DIY Blueprint tool: needs a key whose plan includes them (https://thirdhemisphere.agency/ai-authority-index/data#blueprint-diy).

blueprint_id.description: From list_my_blueprints. Optional when the address has one Blueprint.
